senses.gloss: the distance or length between two points or supports

definition_translations.zh_TW: 兩點或支撐物之間的距離或長度
definition_translations.ja_JP: 二点または支柱間の距離や長さ
definition_translations.ko_KR: 두 지점이나 지지대 사이의 거리 또는 길이
definition_translations.vi_VN: khoảng cách hoặc chiều dài giữa hai điểm hoặc điểm tựa
definition_translations.th_TH: ระยะหรือความยาวระหว่างสองจุดหรือส่วนรองรับ

senses.gloss: the period of time that something lasts
senses.example: The project was completed within a span of three months.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這個專案在三個月的期間內完成。
example_translations.ja_JP: そのプロジェクトは3か月の期間内に完了しました。
example_translations.vi_VN: Dự án đã được hoàn thành trong khoảng thời gian ba tháng.
example_translations.th_TH: โครงการเสร็จสิ้นภายในระยะเวลาสามเดือน

definition_translations.vi_VN: khoảng thời gian mà điều gì đó kéo dài
definition_translations.th_TH: ช่วงเวลาที่บางสิ่งคงอยู่

senses.gloss: to extend across an area, distance, or period
senses.example: The company's operations span several countries.

example_translations.zh_TW: 該公司的營運橫跨多個國家。
example_translations.ja_JP: その会社の事業は複数の国にまたがっています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 회사의 사업은 여러 국가에 걸쳐 있습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Hoạt động của công ty trải rộng trên nhiều quốc gia.
example_translations.th_TH: การดำเนินงานของบริษัทครอบคลุมหลายประเทศ

definition_translations.zh_TW: 橫跨某個區域、距離或時期
definition_translations.ja_JP: 地域、距離、または期間にわたって広がる
definition_translations.ko_KR: 지역, 거리 또는 기간에 걸쳐 뻗다
definition_translations.vi_VN: trải rộng qua một khu vực, khoảng cách hoặc giai đoạn
definition_translations.th_TH: ทอดข้ามพื้นที่ ระยะทาง หรือช่วงเวลา

translations.th_TH: ช่วงทั่วไป
การใช้ช่วง
